parameters.help_en: Group key, which represents a multi-turn conversation or an order operation. Multiple rounds of conversation sharing the same group key are automatically merged into a single ticket with multiple conversation entries
parameters.help_zh: 分组键，代表了一次对话或者一次下单操作，多轮对话使用一个groupkey，会自动合并成一条工单多条对话的形式
parameters.name: group_key

Message.title_zh: 附加信息，典型应用场景是对失败调用进行简述，方便调用方定位问题

StatusCode.description_en: The return code of the invocation. Except for the predefined SUCCESS_CODE, all other codes are custom-defined by the service provider
StatusCode.description_zh: 调用返回码，除约定的SUCCESS_CODE外，其余由服务提供者自定义
